description_en: The UpdateConsumerOffset operation resets the consumer offset of a consumer group
description_zh: 通过 UpdateConsumerOffset 重置消费者组的消费位点
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka update-consumer-offset --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-mp91inkw0000 --topic topic_name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --consumer-id kafka-test --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateConsumerOffset

parameters.help_en:
Topic name.

Can only contain letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Length must be 3-64 characters. If more than 64 characters are provided, they will be automatically truncated.

Cannot be modified once created.

To set the consumer offset for all topics subscribed by the current consumer, pass an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
Topic 的名称。

只能包含字母、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
长度为 3-64 个字符，多于 64 个字符将被自动截取。
一旦创建后不能再修改。

若需针对当前消费者所订阅的所有主题设置消费位点，请传入空字符串
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: Region ID of the instance to which the Group belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Consumer Group name.

Can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Length must be 3-64 characters. If more than 64 characters are provided, they will be automatically truncated.

Cannot be modified once created
parameters.help_zh:
Consumer Group 名称。

只能包含字母、数字、短横线（-）、下划线（_）。
长度限制在 3-64 个字符，多于 64 个字符将被自动截取。
一旦创建后不能再修改
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en:
Type of consumer group offset reset, supporting the following two types:

timestamp (default)

offset
parameters.help_zh:
重置消费者组消费位点的类型，支持以下两种：

timestamp（默认）
offset
parameters.name: reset_type

parameters.help_en:
Time parameter in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds.
The parameter range should be less than 0 or within the retention period of the consumer offset. This parameter only takes effect when resetType is timestamp.

To reset to the latest consumer offset, pass -1.

To reset to the earliest consumer offset, pass -2
parameters.help_zh:
传入的时间参数，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
参数范围应小于0或在消费位点的保留时间范围内，仅在resetType为timestamp时作用生效。

若希望重置为最新的消费位点，请传入-1。

若希望重置为最早的消费位点，请传入-2
parameters.name: time

parameters.help_en: When resetType is offset, this parameter is used to set the consumer offset for each partition of a topic for the consumer group
parameters.help_zh: 当resetType为offset时，用于设置消费者组对于某一主题下各个分区的消费位点
parameters.name: offsets

Code.description_en: Return code. A return value of 200 indicates success
Code.description_zh: 返回码。返回 200 代表成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
